de.title: FOCUS 1.5 bringt natives AI-Token-Tracking und Price Sheets
de.titleCore: FOCUS 1.5 bringt natives AI-Token-Tracking und Price Sheets
de.description: FOCUS 1.5 erscheint im Dezember 2026 mit AI-Token-Tracking und Price Sheets. Was die FinOps-Spezifikation standardisiert und wie Sie Abrechnungen vorbereiten.
de.body:
Die FinOps Foundation hat bestätigt, dass FOCUS 1.5 im Dezember 2026 erscheint. Erstmals erhält die Open Cost and Usage Specification native Datenfelder für künstliche Intelligenz: Modellidentifikatoren, getrennte Zähler für Input- und Output-Token sowie ein eigenständiges Price Sheet Dataset für die Listenpreise der Anbieter.

1. Was FOCUS 1.5 standardisiert

Bislang rechnete jeder Cloud- und Modellanbieter nach eigenen Regeln ab: Rohdaten von Bedrock, Azure OpenAI und Google Cloud Vertex ließen sich nicht ohne manuelle Transformation vergleichen. FOCUS 1.5 vereinheitlicht das Datenformat:

  • Model Identifier: Herstellerübergreifende Benennung des aufgerufenen Modells.
  • Token Metrics: Separate Spalten für Eingabe-, Ausgabe- und Cache-Token statt aggregierter Pauschalwerte.
  • Price Sheet Dataset: Klare Trennung zwischen Listenpreis und tatsächlichem Verbrauch, um Rabatte und Commitments transparent zu machen.

2. Was FOCUS 1.5 nicht löst

FOCUS 1.5 standardisiert die Rechnungsdaten der Anbieter, löst aber nicht die interne Kostenzuordnung. Der Provider weiß nicht, welches Produktfeature, welcher Kunde oder welches Team einen API-Aufruf ausgelöst hat. Die Attribution erfordert weiterhin eigenes Tagging am internen AI-Gateway.

3. Vorbereitung auf die Einführung

Beginnen Sie schon heute damit, Token nach Typ zu erfassen, Modell-IDs in jedem Aufruf mitzuführen und Provider-Listenpreise zum Zeitpunkt der Ausführung einzufrieren. So lassen sich Ihre Daten nahtlos in FOCUS 1.5 überführen.

faq.question: Was ist FOCUS 1.5?
faq.answer: FOCUS 1.5 ist die Version der FinOps Open Cost and Usage Specification vom Dezember 2026 mit nativer Unterstützung für AI-Token und Price-Sheet-Listenpreise.

faq.question: Löst FOCUS 1.5 die interne Kostenaufteilung?
faq.answer: Nein. FOCUS vereinheitlicht die Abrechnungsformate der Provider; die Zuordnung zu Teams, Features und Kunden erfordert weiterhin Tagging am Gateway.

faq.question: Wie bereiten sich FinOps-Teams auf FOCUS 1.5 vor?
faq.answer: Erfassen Sie Token getrennt nach Typ (Input, Output, Cache), speichern Sie Modell-IDs je Aufruf und gleichen Sie Rechnungen monatlich ab.

ja.title: FOCUS 1.5：AIトークン追跡とPrice Sheet標準化の全貌
ja.titleCore: FOCUS 1.5：AIトークン追跡とPrice Sheet標準化の全貌
ja.description: 2026年12月リリースのFOCUS 1.5はAIトークン追跡とPrice Sheetデータセットを標準化。請求スキーマの統一、プロバイダー価格比較、FinOps準備を解説。
ja.body:
FinOps Foundation は FOCUS 1.5 を 2026 年 12 月に確定仕様としてリリースします。FinOps Open Cost and Usage Specification に初めて AI ネイティブなトークン消費フィールドが追加され、モデル識別子、入力および出力トークン量、さらにプロバイダー定価を扱う Price Sheet データセット が新設されます。

1. FOCUS 1.5 が標準化するもの

これまで Bedrock、Azure OpenAI、Vertex AI などクラウドごとにバラバラだった請求形式が、単一の標準スキーマに統合されます：

  • モデル識別子の標準化： プロバイダーをまたいだ統一名称。
  • トークン種別の分離： 入力、出力、キャッシュ読み取りトークンを独立した列として記録。
  • Price Sheet データセット： 消費ログと公表定価を分離し、実効割引率の監査を容易化。

2. FOCUS 1.5 が解決しない領域

FOCUS はプロバイダーが発行するデータの規格化であり、自社内の利用部門別アトリビューションは解決しません。どの機能や顧客が呼び出しを行ったかはプロバイダーには見えないため、社内 AI ゲートウェイでのタグ付けとコンテキスト伝播が引き続き必須です。

3. 今から準備すべきこと

トークン総量ではなく種別ごとにログを保持し、呼び出しごとにモデル ID を記録し、実行時の価格表を保存しておくことで、1.5 への移行がスムーズになります。

faq.question: FOCUS 1.5 とは何ですか？
faq.answer: FinOps Foundationが策定する費用・利用量オープン仕様の次期バージョンで、AIモデルのトークン消費と価格表の標準形式を定義します。

faq.question: FOCUS 1.5 で社内費用配賦は自動化されますか？
faq.answer: いいえ。プロバイダー請求書の標準化にとどまるため、チームや機能への帰属付けには自社ゲートウェイでのタグ付けが必要です。

faq.question: チームはどのように備えるべきですか？
faq.answer: 入力・出力・キャッシュのトークン種別を分離して保存し、モデルIDを常に記録し、請求書との月次突合体制を整えます。

fr.title: FOCUS 1.5 : suivi natif des jetons IA et Price Sheet
fr.titleCore: FOCUS 1.5 : suivi natif des jetons IA et Price Sheet
fr.description: FOCUS 1.5 arrive en décembre 2026 avec le suivi natif des jetons IA et un jeu de données Price Sheet. Ce qui est standardisé et comment préparer votre FinOps.
fr.body:
La FinOps Foundation a validé la sortie de FOCUS 1.5 pour décembre 2026. Cette spécification apporte pour la première fois un suivi natif des jetons d'IA au schéma de facturation cloud, avec l'identification du modèle, la distinction entrée/sortie et un jeu de données dédié Price Sheet.

1. Les apports majeurs de FOCUS 1.5

  • Identifiant de modèle normalisé : Facilite la comparaison entre AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI et GCP.
  • Mesures de jetons distinctes : Colonnes séparées pour l'entrée, la sortie et les jetons en cache.
  • Jeu de données Price Sheet : Découplage clair entre grille tarifaire publique et consommation réelle.

2. Ce que FOCUS ne prend pas en charge

La norme standardise la sortie des fournisseurs cloud, mais ne résout pas l'attribution interne. Les fournisseurs ignorent quelle équipe ou fonctionnalité a émis la requête. L'étiquetage au niveau de la passerelle reste indispensable.

3. Comment s'y préparer

Conservez dès à présent les métriques de jetons par type, tracez l'identifiant du modèle sur chaque appel et rapprochez mensuellement vos journaux des factures réelles.

faq.question: Qu'est-ce que la norme FOCUS 1.5 ?
faq.answer: C'est la version de la spécification ouverte FinOps de décembre 2026 intégrant les champs de jetons d'IA et la grille de prix Price Sheet.

faq.question: FOCUS 1.5 résout-il l'attribution par équipe ?
faq.answer: Non. Il normalise les exports des fournisseurs cloud, mais l'attribution aux équipes et fonctionnalités exige vos propres tags de passerelle.

faq.question: Comment préparer son architecture à FOCUS 1.5 ?
faq.answer: Ventilez les jetons par catégorie (entrée, sortie, cache), associez l'identifiant modèle à chaque trace et rapprochez la dépense des factures.

es.title: FOCUS 1.5: rastreo nativo de tokens de IA y Price Sheets
es.titleCore: FOCUS 1.5: rastreo nativo de tokens de IA y Price Sheets
es.description: FOCUS 1.5 llega en diciembre de 2026 con rastreo nativo de tokens IA y conjunto de datos Price Sheet. Qué estandariza y cómo preparar su contabilidad FinOps.
es.body:
La FinOps Foundation ha confirmado que FOCUS 1.5 se publicará en diciembre de 2026. Esta versión incorpora por primera vez campos nativos de inteligencia artificial en la especificación abierta de costes: identificación de modelos, conteo desagregado de tokens de entrada y salida, y el nuevo conjunto de datos Price Sheet.

1. Lo que estandariza FOCUS 1.5

  • Identificación de modelos: Nomenclatura uniforme entre proveedores cloud.
  • Métricas de tokens: Desglose en columnas de entrada, salida y tokens en caché.
  • Dataset Price Sheet: Separación entre el catálogo de precios de lista y los eventos de consumo.

2. Límites de la especificación

FOCUS estandariza la facturación emitida por los proveedores, pero no resuelve la atribución interna de costes. El proveedor no sabe qué microservicio o equipo generó la llamada; esa trazabilidad debe registrarse en su propio gateway.

3. Pasos de preparación

Guarde los recuentos de tokens por categoría, asocie el ID del modelo a cada registro y concilie las llamadas con las facturas oficiales cada mes.

faq.question: ¿Qué es FOCUS 1.5?
faq.answer: Es la actualización de diciembre de 2026 de la especificación abierta de FinOps con soporte nativo para tokens de IA y tarifas de lista de proveedores.

faq.question: ¿Resuelve FOCUS la asignación por equipo?
faq.answer: No. Normaliza los datos del proveedor, pero asignar el gasto a equipos internos requiere etiquetas propias aplicadas en la pasarela de llamadas.

faq.question: ¿Cómo prepararse para la llegada de FOCUS 1.5?
faq.answer: Segregue tokens de entrada, salida y caché, mantenga el identificador del modelo en telemetría y concilie los consumos con las facturas.

pt.title: FOCUS 1.5: rastreamento de tokens de IA e Price Sheets
pt.titleCore: FOCUS 1.5: rastreamento de tokens de IA e Price Sheets
pt.description: FOCUS 1.5 chega em dezembro de 2026 com rastreamento nativo de tokens de IA e Price Sheets. O que muda na especificação e como preparar a sua faturação FinOps.
pt.body:
A FinOps Foundation confirmou o lançamento da especificação FOCUS 1.5 para dezembro de 2026. Pela primeira vez, a especificação aberta de custos e uso de nuvem ganha suporte nativo para inteligência artificial, trazendo identificação padronizada de modelos e o dataset Price Sheet.

1. O que o FOCUS 1.5 padroniza

  • Identificador de modelo: Normalização entre Bedrock, Azure OpenAI e Google Vertex.
  • Métricas de tokens: Campos separados para entrada, saída e tokens de cache.
  • Price Sheet: Tabela de preços de lista desvinculada do log de consumo para auditoria clara de descontos.

2. O que continua sob responsabilidade da empresa

O FOCUS normaliza os dados do fornecedor, mas não resolve a atribuição interna de custos. O provedor não sabe qual time ou funcionalidade originou o pedido; essa demarcação precisa existir no gateway de IA da empresa.

3. Como se preparar

Passe a registrar tokens por tipo e não por total agregado, guarde os IDs de modelo em cada span e faça conciliação mensal com a fatura do provedor.

faq.question: O que é o FOCUS 1.5?
faq.answer: É a versão de dezembro de 2026 da especificação aberta de FinOps que introduz campos nativos de tokens de IA e catálogo de preços de lista.

faq.question: O FOCUS 1.5 resolve a alocação por equipe?
faq.answer: Não. Ele padroniza a fatura do fornecedor, mas a alocação interna exige tagueamento próprio no gateway de IA.

faq.question: Como se preparar para o FOCUS 1.5?
faq.answer: Separe tokens de entrada, saída e cache, mantenha IDs de modelos na telemetria e reconcilie os relatórios com as faturas mensalmente.

it.title: FOCUS 1.5: tracciamento nativo dei token AI e Price Sheet
it.titleCore: FOCUS 1.5: tracciamento nativo dei token AI e Price Sheet
it.description: FOCUS 1.5 arriva a dicembre 2026 con il tracciamento nativo dei token AI e il dataset Price Sheet. Come standardizza i costi e come preparare il team FinOps.
it.body:
La FinOps Foundation ha confermato l'uscita della specifica FOCUS 1.5 per dicembre 2026. Per la prima volta lo standard aperto per i costi cloud introduce campi nativi per i carichi di lavoro AI: identificatore del modello, tracciamento distinto dei token di input e output e un dataset dedicato Price Sheet per i listini dei provider.

1. I vantaggi di FOCUS 1.5

  • Standardizzazione del modello: Denominazione coerente tra cloud provider eterogenei.
  • Metriche token dettagliate: Campi separati per input, output e letture da cache invece di somme indistinte.
  • Dataset Price Sheet: Distinzione netta tra listini ufficiali e consumi effettivi per verificare sconti negoziati.

2. Limiti della specifica

FOCUS standardizza le fatture generate dai cloud provider, ma non risolve l'attribuzione interna aziendale. I fornitori non conoscono quale funzionalità o centro di costo abbia inviato la chiamata; tale associazione deve essere garantita dal gateway aziendale.

3. Come prepararsi

Iniziate a memorizzare i token disaggregati per tipologia, mantenete l'identificatore del modello in ogni record e riconciliate mensilmente la telemetria con le fatture ufficiali.

faq.question: Che cos'è FOCUS 1.5?
faq.answer: È la release di dicembre 2026 dello standard FinOps per i costi cloud, arricchita con campi nativi per i token AI e i listini ufficiali dei provider.

faq.question: FOCUS 1.5 ripartisce automaticamente i costi tra i team?
faq.answer: No. Normalizza i flussi di dati dei cloud provider, ma l'attribuzione ai team interni richiede tag applicati direttamente dal vostro gateway AI.

faq.question: Come prepararsi all'adozione di FOCUS 1.5?
faq.answer: Tracciate token di input, output e cache separatamente, registrate gli identificatori di modello e riconciliate i dati con le fatture.

ko.title: FOCUS 1.5: AI 토큰 추적과 Price Sheet 표준화의 핵심
ko.titleCore: FOCUS 1.5: AI 토큰 추적과 Price Sheet 표준화의 핵심
ko.description: 2026년 12월 확정된 FOCUS 1.5 사양은 AI 토큰 추적과 Price Sheet 데이터셋을 표준화합니다. 공급업체 청구서 정규화와 엔터프라이즈 FinOps 준비 방안.
ko.body:
FinOps Foundation은 FOCUS 1.5 사양을 2026년 12월 정식 확정한다고 발표했습니다. 클라우드 비용 및 사용량 표준 사양에 사상 처음으로 인공지능 네이티브 필드가 도입되어, 호출된 AI 모델 식별자, 입력 및 출력 토큰 소비량, 그리고 공급업체 공시 정가를 담는 Price Sheet 데이터셋이 신설됩니다.

1. FOCUS 1.5가 표준화하는 핵심 항목

  • 통일된 모델 식별자: AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, GCP Vertex AI 간의 상이한 모델 명칭을 단일 기준으로 표준화.
  • 세분화된 토큰 메트릭: 단순 합산이 아닌 입력, 출력, 캐시 읽기 토큰을 독립된 열로 규정.
  • Price Sheet 데이터셋: 정가 가격표와 실제 사용량 레코드를 분리하여 약정 할인율의 실효성을 명확히 감사.

2. 사양이 해결해주지 않는 영역

FOCUS는 공급업체가 내보내는 인보이스 데이터의 표준일 뿐이며, 기업 내부 조직별 비용 배부를 대신해주지 않습니다. 어떤 제품 기능이나 팀이 호출을 발생시켰는지는 공급업체가 알 수 없으므로, 내부 AI 게이트웨이 태깅이 여전히 필수적입니다.

3. 기업이 지금 준비해야 할 과제

토큰 소비량을 유형별로 분리 저장하고, 호출마다 모델 ID를 1급 필드로 보존하며, 호출 시점의 공급업체 가격표를 동결 보관하십시오.

faq.question: FOCUS 1.5란 무엇인가요?
faq.answer: FinOps Foundation이 주도하는 클라우드 비용 사양의 최신 버전으로, AI 모델 토큰과 공급업체 공시 정가를 표준 형식으로 규정합니다.

faq.question: FOCUS 1.5로 팀별 비용 배부가 자동 해결되나요?
faq.answer: 아닙니다. 공급업체 데이터 표준화일 뿐이며, 사내 팀 및 기능별 비용 배부는 자체 AI 게이트웨이 태그를 통해 수행해야 합니다.

faq.question: FOCUS 1.5에 대비해 무엇을 준비해야 하나요?
faq.answer: 입력, 출력, 캐시 토큰을 분리 기록하고 모델 식별자를 보존하며, 공급업체 원천 청구서와 매월 대사 작업을 진행합니다.

zh.title: FOCUS 1.5规范：AI Token追踪与价格表数据集标准化
zh.titleCore: FOCUS 1.5规范：AI Token追踪与价格表数据集标准化
zh.description: FOCUS 1.5规范为企业带来了原生的AI Token跟踪标准与Price Sheet价格表数据集。解析规范变化、供应商账单归一化与FinOps准备指南。
zh.body:
FinOps基金会宣布FOCUS 1.5规范将于2026年12月正式定稿。作为云成本与用量格式标准，FOCUS首次引入了原生AI字段支持：标准化模型标识符、输入输出Token计量单位，以及独立记录供应商基准单价的价格表（Price Sheet）数据集。

1. FOCUS 1.5的核心标准化内容

  • 统一模型标识符：消除AWS Bedrock、Azure OpenAI与GCP Vertex对同一基础模型的混乱命名，确立跨云对照标准。
  • 多维Token粒度拆分：严格区分输入Token、输出Token与前缀缓存读取Token，不再粗暴汇总为单一用量。
  • Price Sheet独立数据集：将标准刊例价与用量明细剥离，让企业清晰审计承诺折扣与实效费率。

2. 规范无法解决的内部治理盲区

FOCUS解决的是云供应商账单的格式标准化，无法代替企业内部的成本分摊（Cost Allocation）。供应商无法得知是哪个业务功能或微服务发起了调用，内部AI网关标签仍然是精准计费的基石。

3. 企业工程团队应对建议

按Token类型细化遥测存储，将模型标识符升级为一级审计字段，并在调用发生时冻结留存当期价目表快照。

faq.question: 什么是FOCUS 1.5规范？
faq.answer: FOCUS 1.5是FinOps基金会制定的开放云成本规范，首度原生定义了AI Token计量与供应商价格表标准格式。

faq.question: FOCUS 1.5能自动解决团队内部成本归属吗？
faq.answer: 不能。它仅规范供应商账单，内部业务单元与功能的成本分摊仍需依靠企业自身的AI网关埋点标签。

faq.question: 企业应如何为FOCUS 1.5做好准备？
faq.answer: 按输入、输出与缓存细化Token遥测存储，记录完整全局模型ID，并在调用发生时冻结留存价目表快照，建立常态化对账流水线。

nl.title: FOCUS 1.5: AI-token tracking en price sheets voor FinOps
nl.titleCore: FOCUS 1.5: AI-token tracking en price sheets voor FinOps
nl.description: De FOCUS 1.5 specificatie standaardiseert AI-token tracking en price sheets. Ontdek hoe u multi-cloud AI-facturen normaliseert en intern toewijst.
nl.body:
De FinOps Foundation heeft aangekondigd dat de FOCUS 1.5 specificatie in december 2026 definitief wordt. Voor het eerst bevat de standaard voor cloudkosten native velden voor kunstmatige intelligentie: eenduidige model-identificatie, gesplitste token-tellingen en een aparte Price Sheet dataset voor officiële lijstprijzen.

1. Wat FOCUS 1.5 standaardiseert

  • Uniforme modelnamen: Bedrock, Azure OpenAI en Vertex AI hanteren voortaan vergelijkbare model-ID's.
  • Gedetailleerde token-kolommen: Strikte scheiding tussen input-, output- en cache-read tokens in plaats van één vaag totaal.
  • Price Sheet dataset: Scheiding tussen contracttarieven en daadwerkelijk verbruik om kortingen transparant te auditen.

2. Wat de specificatie niet oplost

FOCUS regelt alleen de data van de cloudleverancier. Het lost geen interne kostentoewijzing op: leveranciers weten immers niet welke interne applicatie of klant een prompt verstuurde. API-gateway tags blijven noodzakelijk.

3. Voorbereiding voor FinOps-teams

Sla tokentypes gescheiden op in uw telemetrie, bewaar het exacte model-ID bij elke trace en bevries historische prijzen bij elke transactie.

faq.question: Wat is de FOCUS 1.5 specificatie?
faq.answer: De nieuwste open cloud-kostenstandaard van de FinOps Foundation met native ondersteuning voor AI-tokens en leveranciersprijslijsten.

faq.question: Lost FOCUS 1.5 interne kostentoewijzing op?
faq.answer: Nee. Het standaardiseert leveranciersfacturen; toewijzing aan interne teams vereist tagging via uw eigen AI-gateway.

faq.question: Hoe bereidt u zich voor op FOCUS 1.5?
faq.answer: Sla tokens gesplitst op naar input/output/cache, behoud modelidentificaties en voer maandelijkse factuurreconciliaties uit.

ar.title: معيار FOCUS 1.5 لتتبع رموز الذكاء الاصطناعي
ar.titleCore: معيار FOCUS 1.5 لتتبع رموز الذكاء الاصطناعي
ar.description: إصدار FOCUS 1.5 يدعم تتبع رموز الذكاء الاصطناعي وقوائم الأسعار القياسية. ما يوفره المعيار وكيف تستعد فرق التكاليف للفواتير.
ar.body:
أعلنت مؤسسة FinOps أن معيار FOCUS 1.5 (مواصفة التكلفة والاستخدام السحابي المفتوحة) يضم لأول مرة دعماً أصيلاً وموحداً لتتبع استهلاك رموز الذكاء الاصطناعي التوليدي وقوائم أسعار المزودين، مما يمثل نقلة نوعية في الشفافية المالية السحابية.

1. ما الذي يوفره معيار FOCUS 1.5

سابقاً، كان كل مزود سحابي (مثل AWS Bedrock و Azure OpenAI و Google Cloud Vertex AI) يصدر فواتير الاستدلال بتنسيقات متباينة ومسميات غير موحدة، مما يصعب مقارنتها مباشرة. يوحد FOCUS 1.5 هذه البيانات عبر:

  • معرف النموذج الموحد (Model Identifier): تسمية قياسية عبر جميع المزودين للنموذج المستدعى.
  • مقاييس الرموز المفصلة (Token Metrics): أعمدة مستقلة لرموز الإدخال والإخراج ورموز القراءة من التخزين المؤقت بدلاً من الأرقام الإجمالية المبهمة.
  • مجموعة بيانات قائمة الأسعار (Price Sheet Dataset): فصل واضح بين الأسعار المعلنة والاستهلاك الفعلي لحساب نسب الخصم والالتزامات بدقة.

2. ما لا يقدمه FOCUS 1.5

يوحد المعيار بيانات فواتير المزودين الخارجيين، لكنه لا يحل مشكلة إسناد التكاليف داخلياً بين الفرق والميزات والعملاء. لا يعرف المزود أي ميزة داخل تطبيقك استدعت النموذج، لذلك يظل وضع الوسوم (Tagging) وتمرير السياق عبر بوابة الذكاء الاصطناعي الداخلية مسؤولية المؤسسة.

3. الاستعداد لتطبيق المعيار

يمكن لفرق FinOps الاستعداد من الآن عبر فصل تسجيل الرموز بحسب نوعها، والاحتفاظ بمعرف النموذج لكل استدعاء، وحفظ نسخ من جداول أسعار المزودين وقت التنفيذ لضمان مطابقة سلسة وفورية مع صدور الفواتير المتوافقة مع FOCUS 1.5.

faq.question: ما هو معيار FOCUS 1.5 لإدارة التكاليف؟
faq.answer: هو مواصفة مفتوحة لتكاليف واستخدام السحابة من مؤسسة FinOps تدعم حقول رموز الذكاء الاصطناعي وقوائم الأسعار.

faq.question: هل يحل FOCUS 1.5 مسألة توزيع التكاليف داخلياً؟
faq.answer: لا، المعيار يوحد بيانات فواتير المزودين، بينما يتطلب التوزيع الداخلي على الفرق وضع وسوم على بوابات الذكاء.

faq.question: كيف تستعد فرق FinOps لاعتماد معيار FOCUS 1.5؟
faq.answer: بتسجيل الرموز مقسمة حسب النوع (إدخال وإخراج وتخزين مؤقت) وحفظ معرف النموذج لكل استدعاء وتجميد قوائم الأسعار.

en.title: FOCUS 1.5 adds AI token tracking
en.description: FOCUS 1.5 lands December 2026 with native AI token tracking and a new Price Sheet dataset. What it standardizes, what it does not, and how to be ready.
en.body:
FOCUS 1.5 is confirmed for December 2026 and adds two things the specification has never carried: native AI token tracking inside the Cost and Usage dataset, and a separate Price Sheet dataset for provider list pricing. Together they make token-based AI spend comparable and portable across providers, the way FOCUS already made cloud billing comparable.

What is actually in it

Two additions, and the second matters more than its billing gets:

1. AI model identity and token consumption in Cost and Usage

The consumption record gains fields for which model served a charge and how many input and output tokens it consumed, with worked examples for token-based and generation-based billing. Today that information either does not survive the provider's export or arrives in a provider-specific shape you have to parse per vendor. After 1.5, the shape is the same everywhere.

2. A Price Sheet dataset

List pricing gets its own standardized representation, separate from the consumption record. This is the quieter but more useful half. Keeping price separate from usage means you can finally compute two things directly from the data:

  • List versus actual. The gap between the published rate and your effective rate - the number that tells you whether a commitment or a negotiated rate is earning its keep.
  • Provider comparison without archaeology. Comparing two vendors currently means reverse-engineering an effective rate out of an invoice that blends discounts, tiers, and cached-token pricing. A price sheet in a known schema removes that step. See provider arbitrage.

Why this matters more than a normal point release

Token spend has been the one large technology cost with no standard billing shape. Every provider meters differently, cached and reasoning tokens price on their own scales, and the ratios move whenever a model changes underneath you. That is why the State of FinOps 2026 survey put granular AI spend monitoring - tokens, requests, GPU utilization - at the top of the most-requested capability list across all 1,192 respondents.

FOCUS 1.5 does not deliver that capability, but it removes the excuse that the data is unobtainable. Once tokens are a first-class billing field, a tool that cannot report on them by model is choosing not to.

What FOCUS 1.5 will not do

Be clear about this before you plan around it, because the gap is where most teams get caught:

  • It does not give you attribution. FOCUS standardizes what providers emit. Providers do not know which feature, team, or customer caused a request, because that context never leaves your infrastructure. A request made without a tag is unattributable regardless of how good the billing schema is. See cost attribution.
  • It does not cover the unmetered layers. GPU reservations, vector stores, eval harnesses, and human review sit outside the token line. See hidden LLM costs.
  • It does not arrive on the spec date. A December 2026 specification is not a December 2026 export. FOCUS 1.0 took well over a year to reach broad provider coverage. Plan for usable AI exports through 2027, not in Q1.
  • It does not tell you whether the spend was worth it. That is the layer the Tokenomics Foundation was launched to define.

How to be ready, using work that pays for itself now

Every item below is useful before 1.5 ships and maps directly onto a 1.5 field afterwards:

Do this nowWhy it maps cleanly
Store token counts by type, never as one totalInput and output are separate fields in 1.5. A single blended total cannot be split back apart.
Keep model identity on every recordModel identity is a first-class 1.5 field and the basis of every per-model comparison.
Retain provider list prices at time of useThe Price Sheet dataset is a point-in-time view. Historical list prices are not reliably recoverable later.
Reconcile internal records to the invoice monthly1.5 will make the provider's version authoritative and comparable. An unreconciled internal figure becomes visibly wrong. See invoice reconciliation.
Tag at the gateway: feature, environment, team, customerThe one thing FOCUS will never supply. Emit it via OpenTelemetry GenAI conventions.

The wider signal

FOCUS 1.5 did not arrive alone. The same window produced the Tokenomics Foundation launch on 4 August 2026, and the announcement that from 2027 FinOps X becomes Tokenomicon, a Linux Foundation conference built around the economics of AI, with FinOps X continuing as a co-located practitioner track. The flagship runs in San Diego, 7-10 June 2027, with regional events in Amsterdam and London.

A specification adding token fields, a new standards body, and a conference renamed around the unit is three independent bodies agreeing on the same thing: the token is now the unit of enterprise technology spend, and the accounting is being built after the fact. Being early to the schema is cheap. Retrofitting it is not.

Related

  • LLM FinOps standards - the wider standards picture.
  • What is the Tokenomics Foundation? - the value layer above the schema.
  • State of FinOps 2026: 98% now manage AI spend - the capability gap 1.5 partly addresses.
  • OpenTelemetry GenAI conventions - the telemetry side of the same problem.
  • LLM token types explained - why one blended total is not enough.

faq.question: What is FOCUS 1.5?
faq.answer: FOCUS 1.5 is the next version of the FinOps Open Cost and Usage Specification, confirmed for December 2026. It adds native AI token tracking to the Cost and Usage dataset - surfacing AI model identity and input and output token consumption - plus a new Price Sheet dataset for provider list pricing.

faq.question: What does the Price Sheet dataset do?
faq.answer: It gives list pricing its own standardized representation, separate from the consumption record. That separation is what lets you compute the gap between list price and what you actually paid, and compare provider pricing without reverse-engineering it out of an invoice.

faq.question: Does FOCUS 1.5 solve AI cost attribution?
faq.answer: No. FOCUS standardizes the shape of billing data coming out of providers. It cannot tell you which feature, team, or customer caused a given request, because that context never reaches the provider. Attribution still requires your own tagging at the gateway.

faq.question: When does FOCUS 1.5 ship and when will providers support it?
faq.answer: The specification is confirmed for December 2026. Provider adoption follows on its own schedule - FOCUS 1.0 took well over a year to reach broad coverage across major clouds. Plan for a spec date in 2026 and usable exports through 2027.

faq.question: How do we prepare for FOCUS 1.5?
faq.answer: Store token counts by type rather than a single total, keep model identity as a first-class field on every record, retain provider list prices at the time of use, and keep your internal cost records reconciled to the invoice. Each maps directly onto a 1.5 field.

faq.question: Is FOCUS the same as the Tokenomics Foundation?
faq.answer: No. FOCUS standardizes billing data - the schema of what providers export. The Tokenomics Foundation, launched 4 August 2026, targets the layer above: what that spend means in business terms and what a token is worth. They are complementary and land in that order.
